name: command_run
description: Run tools as a pure batch+step command runner.

timeout_ms.description: Default timeout in ms for commands without their own timeout_ms.

stall_timeout_ms.description: No-output watchdog in ms, independent of timeout_ms. Omit for silent workloads.

execution_id.description: Stable execution identity for receipts and diagnosed replay.

commands.description: Executable instructions. Batch all currently known work; prefer 5 or more commands when useful. For simple standalone tasks, 1-2 commands are acceptable. Independent commands share one step; dependencies use later steps and may bind earlier JSON output.

command_type.description: Command name from the available list; use flattened names exactly.

command_line.description: Command payload string. source_read: prefer JSON ["path",1,50,null,true] = [path,start_line,end_line,expected_sha256,line_numbers]; omit trailing optionals. Named range/search objects remain valid. JSON projection: named {"path":"capsule.json","json_pointer":"/field"}, optional expected_sha256, no line/search options. RFC 6901 string; empty pointer selects whole JSON only within the existing range budgets (12288 text bytes, 16384 serialized result bytes including receipts). Returns compact selected JSON, projection metadata and source file SHA, not line coverage or pagination; invalid/missing/oversized selections fail without partial output. Exact granted paths, full SHA pins; range/search next_line pagination, max 200 lines. Other JSON-schema tools: escaped object strings; freeform: raw bodies; shell-like: text.

id.description: Optional output-binding name; otherwise command_type is used.

timeout_ms.description: Per-command timeout in ms; overrides top-level timeout_ms.

stall_timeout_ms.description: Per-command no-output watchdog in ms; overrides top-level stall_timeout_ms.

step.description: Dependency group/order. Same-step commands run together and must be independent; dependencies and post-edit validation use later steps. Put compact_context after the work it summarizes.
